subject: Your Lenskart Interest: Vincent Chase Computer Glasses & Gold Membership
body:
Dear Alex,

It was a pleasure speaking with you today regarding your interest in Lenskart eyewear. I understand you're looking for Vincent Chase computer glasses with zero power and Blu-cut lenses to help with eye strain. That's an excellent choice for protecting your eyes!

You also showed interest in our Lenskart Gold Membership, which offers an exclusive 'Buy 1 Get 1 Free' on all eyeglasses and sunglasses, valid for a year and applicable to your entire family. This is a fantastic way to get more value out of your purchase.

I hope you enjoy exploring our frame options online. Please feel free to reply to this email if you'd like us to help you pick out frames, learn more about the Gold Membership benefits, or if you'd like to schedule a convenient 'Home Eye Check-up' in Mumbai. We're here to help you find the perfect pair!

Warm regards,
Riya
Your Lenskart SDR
